title: Verify bee-rs is clippy-clean with behavior unchanged
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml

truths: clippy -D warnings exits 0 on the default targets
the lib and bin test count is not lower than the base 5229 bin tests
the only workspace clippy allows are too_many_arguments and result_large_err and no item-level clippy allow was added
no code comment was added by cwc-1 or cwc-2
every deleted dead_code item has no caller in any target
the report under docs/history/clippy-warnings-clean/reports/ lists each check with its result

action: Check contract clippy-warnings-clean (decision 4a500653) on the cwc-1 and cwc-2 commits. Run the verify command. Diff the two commits against the feature base: rg the added lines for '#[allow(clippy' and for new comment lines (// or ///, not removals); list every deleted fn, struct, const or enum and rg the whole crate, tests included, for each name; read the non-mechanical hunks of cwc-2 for any behavior change (changed condition, changed output text, changed order). Compare the bin test count with the base 5229. Write docs/history/clippy-warnings-clean/reports/cwc-3.md with each check, the command and the result. Edit no source file. If a check fails, return BLOCKED with the evidence. Commit the report once (cell trailer).
